::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Meta's Infra Silicon team in Bengaluru designs custom ASICs for data centre workloads including video transcoding and AI inference. Actively hiring ASIC design and verification engineers.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Domain-specific SoCs and ASICs for Meta's data centres, covering architecture, RTL design, verification, and physical design for AI/ML inference and video processing accelerators.
